title: Flija
description: A traditional Kosovo dish made with all-purpose flour, chicken egg, heavy cream, sour cream. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 17 minutes.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Build alternating layers of thin batter sheets and warm cream, briefly grilling each layer as in traditional flija; use a home oven grill and rotate the pan carefully.
Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for about 95 minutes until set, golden and cooked through. Cool on a rack.
